name: larvae
description: Formatting and lint diagnostics for Luau, powered by the larvae toolchain

larvae.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `larvae` executable. Leave empty to use `larvae` from `PATH` (falling back to `~/.larvae/bin/larvae`).

larvae.processOnSave.markdownDescription: Run `larvae process` for the containing workspace folder whenever a Luau file is saved. (This is also done in process watch mode)

larvae.processProfile.markdownDescription: Profile to pass to `larvae process --profile <name>`, merging `[profile.<name>]` from `larvae.toml` over the base config. Leave empty to build with the base config only.

larvae.hideOutputFolder.markdownDescription: Hide larvae's output directory (the `output` entry in `larvae.toml`) from the explorer by managing a `files.exclude` entry in the workspace settings. Only applies to folders that contain a `larvae.toml`.

larvae.luauFiles.markdownDescription: Attach the language server to plain Luau and Lua files, making larvae a drop-in for luau-lsp. Off (the default), larvae only serves worm-claimed files (e.g. `.luaux`) and runs side by side with luau-lsp. A workspace's `larvae.toml` can force side-by-side with `worm_files_only = true` under `[lint]`.

larvae.completion.autocompleteEnd.markdownDescription: Insert the closing `end` when completing a block.

larvae.completion.addParentheses.description: Add parentheses when completing a function.

larvae.completion.fillCallArguments.description: Fill parameter names as placeholders when completing a call.

larvae.completion.imports.enabled.description: Suggest symbols from modules that are not required yet and insert the require on accept (auto-imports).

larvae.completion.imports.keyword.markdownDescription: The keyword an inserted require binds with. `const` applies in files whose worm supports it.

larvae.completion.imports.requireStyle.markdownDescription: How an inserted require spells its path: `auto` follows the project's target and existing requires, `relative` always writes `./`-style paths, `aliased` always writes alias paths (e.g. `@game/...`).

larvae.completion.imports.separateGroups.description: Keep inserted requires grouped: services first, then aliased requires, then relative ones.

larvae.hover.enabled.description: Show type information and documentation on hover.

larvae.hover.multilineFunctionDefinition.description: Wrap function signatures in hovers across multiple lines.

larvae.inlayHints.parameterNames.description: Show parameter name hints in call arguments.

larvae.inlayHints.parameterTypes.description: Show type hints on parameters without an annotation.

larvae.inlayHints.variableTypes.description: Show type hints on variables without an annotation.

larvae.inlayHints.functionReturnTypes.description: Show return type hints on functions without an annotation.

larvae.inlayHints.typeHintMaxLength.description: Truncate inlay type hints longer than this.

larvae.signatureHelp.enabled.description: Show signature help while typing call arguments.

larvae.diagnostics.workspace.description: Lint the whole workspace, not only open files.

larvae.diagnostics.includeDependents.description: Re-check files that depend on an edited file.

larvae.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the larvae language server.
